authorize.title: Authorize Sogedo
authorize.description: Open the link below and log in to your Sogedo account. After logging in you will be redirected to a page whose URL contains `code=...`. Copy the value after `code=` and continue.

token.title: Authorization code
token.description: Paste the `code` value from the redirect URL here.

error.invalid_code: The authorization code is invalid or expired. Try again.
